name: Červený Újezd (Benešov District, Czechia)
description: Red field with six white six-pointed stars arranged four and two above an open white book with yellow edges bearing the Greek letters alpha and omega in black.
history: Granted by decision of the Chairman of the Chamber of Deputies of the Czech Parliament on 10 September 2021 and entered in the Register of Municipal Symbols (REKOS); the flag repeats the colours and charges of the municipal arms.

features.role: open book with alpha and omega
